# Kenkenni

\\nThe Kenkenni is the smallest size drum of the dundun set, is the timekeeper and completes the melody of the rhythm.  This drum can be either a soft or hard wood depending on the tone and projection required. This drum is fitted with Australian cow hide on both sides using top quality marine rope. The kenkenni is made to order and you have the option to choose your own rope and fabric colours to complete your individual design.
